interfaces.retry_and_delivery: No distributed delivery/retry protocol. Pack generation reports unchanged when the same pack is already frozen; shared-vault concurrent writer behavior is not a compare-and-swap guarantee.

interfaces.authority_and_auth: API key is the remote authorization credential; configuration entry owns configured value in Home Assistant. No credential values or runtime Home Assistant entries were inspected.

interfaces.live_use: unknown; public source inspected only, no Home Assistant/API invocation
interfaces.persistence_and_data: Home Assistant Store persists energy, economics and analytics state through versioned store keys. Storage backend/retention and installed config contents were not inspected.
interfaces.producer_consumer: Home Assistant integration calls Gridle measurements endpoint and produces `MeasurementData` records/coordinator state; actual Home Assistant installation and consumers unknown.

protocol_and_operations.authentication: x-api-key header; user config flow accepts an API key and stores it in config-entry data; diagnostics source explicitly redacts that field
protocol_and_operations.response: list of measurement objects mapped to MeasurementData; no explicit API schema/version field found

interfaces.retry_and_delivery: Client does not implement request retries. HTTP 401/403 becomes auth failure; HTTP 429 exposes Retry-After and coordinator increases update interval to max(hint, five-minute default) before UpdateFailed. Other API/communication errors become update failures.
